sources.title: Robbers Roost / Dirty Devil
sources.supports: Remote desert canyon network between Hanksville and Canyonlands; association with the Butch Cassidy gang.
sources.does_not_establish: A particular cabin plan, construction date, corral, equipment, or precise material palette.

sources.title: All Were Rattled: Butch Cassidy, The Castle Gate Robbery, and the Wild West
sources.publisher: Utah Division of Archives and Records Service
sources.supports: Canyon terrain provided concealment; the article connects the 1897 Castle Gate escape with the Roost and distinguishes contradictory storytelling from records.
sources.critical_image_limit: Its cabin image is identified as Daggett County, not Robbers Roost. Do not copy it as this site.
